questions.question: What is the naive probability formula for an event $A\subseteq S$?
questions.explanation: Naive probability is favorable over total: $P(A)=\frac{|A|}{|S|}$ when outcomes are equally likely.

$|A||S|$ multiplies the counts, which is not a probability.
$\frac{|S|}{|A|}$ inverts the ratio; favorable belongs on top.
